title: [CONTROL-PLANE SELF-CHECK] Pre-flight doc-only detector for ERP-088: verify .ai/results/ERP-089.json self-presence, that ERP-088's terminal state carries raw_script_invocation or an .ai/audit.jsonl environment-failure record routed to ERP-085, and refuse doc-only closure
description:
CONTROL-PLANE SELF-CHECK, evidence-only, no business logic. Context: review of remote_head=9fd305ce2f2b0e900b3e04b31c48bd30a43a1921 against previous_reviewed_remote_sha=763b14a14cee9b06f5a0c43d152fafba043dad14 returned FAIL. The CHANGES SINCE REVIEW BASELINE diff contains ONLY control-plane text rewrites (.ai/PROJECT_STATE.json wording and the new .ai/tasks/ERP-088.json), there is no .ai/results/ERP-088.json, no .ai/results/ERP-087.json, no raw_script_invocation evidence of scripts/verify-executor-bootstrap.ps1, and GitHub Actions is unreachable (gh 443). The same doc-only pattern was already rejected at 6c715d0, 7959762, 46e3e63 and 763b14a. CONTROL_PLANE_FRESH_PROCESS_REQUIRED remains active and ERP-074/076/077 remain failed.

This task is a MACHINE-CHECKABLE anti-doc-only gate plus a self-proving artifact. It accepts exactly two terminal outcomes and MUST NOT be used as a substitute carrier for ERP-088's real fresh-process execution evidence:
(A) PRE-FLIGHT PASS: (1) inspect the current remote state of .ai/tasks/ERP-088.json, scripts/verify-executor-bootstrap.ps1 and the rolling queue head, and determine whether ERP-088 has ALREADY produced either (i) .ai/results/ERP-088.json containing a non-empty raw_script_invocation object, or (ii) a concrete execution-environment failure record appended to .ai/audit.jsonl that is explicitly routed to ERP-085; (2) write the exact command, timestamp and observed verdict into .ai/results/ERP-089.json at path .ai/results/ERP-089.json (no other location), stating verdict=ERP088_TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_PRESENT with the checksum/source of the observed evidence, or verdict=ERP088_TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_ABSENT with the list of missing fields; (3) in the SAME commit leave .ai/tasks/ERP-088.json, .ai/tasks/ERP-085.json and .ai/PROJECT_STATE.json byte-identical except for ERP-089 bookkeeping that does NOT clear AUTO_CIRCUIT_BREAKER and does NOT change rolling_queue.status from blocked_on_control_plane_verification; and (4) explicitly record in the result file doc_only_closure_attempts_observed (the count of commits 6c715d0, 7959762, 46e3e63, 763b14a that reproduced the pattern) and declare that reintroducing that pattern is rejected.
(B) PRE-FLIGHT BLOCKED: if the repository state cannot be read or the head cannot be resolved, append the exact command, key stderr excerpt, suspected cause and the required human next action to .ai/audit.jsonl, mark this task failed, and explicitly hand off to ERP-085 (human routing, L3). Do not fake closure.

Hard boundaries: this task must NOT implement ERP business logic, must NOT touch any file under src/ERP.*, must NOT access or change production database/OSS, must NOT deploy or release, must NOT reissue an isomorphic control-plane recovery task, and must keep LIVE_TRADING=false and ALLOW_EXTERNAL_ORDER_SUBMISSION=false. Its allowed_paths are restricted to .ai/** so that it can never be used to fabricate script execution.
acceptance_criteria: .ai/results/ERP-089.json exists at that exact path and contains the exact command, timestamp, and one of verdict=ERP088_TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_PRESENT or verdict=ERP088_TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_ABSENT; a commit that edits control-plane JSON text without this file is considered unmet.

The result file records the observed remote state of .ai/tasks/ERP-088.json, scripts/verify-executor-bootstrap.ps1, .ai/results/ERP-088.json and .ai/audit.jsonl, and declares whether ERP-088's raw_script_invocation evidence or routed environment-failure record is PRESENT or ABSENT, with the source of each observation (path + sha or commit id).

The result file records doc_only_closure_attempts_observed with the concrete commit list (at minimum 6c715d0, 7959762, 46e3e63, 763b14a) and explicitly states that a doc-only commit without raw_script_invocation is rejected as unmet.

The task did NOT write or modify .ai/results/ERP-088.json, did NOT modify .ai/tasks/ERP-088.json, and did NOT append a fabricated execution record; a check result showing ERP088_TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_ABSENT is a valid success of this checker task.

.ai/tasks/ERP-085.json remains blocked with auto_start=false, non_executable=true and human_gate.level=L3; AUTO_CIRCUIT_BREAKER is NOT auto-cleared and rolling_queue.status remains blocked_on_control_plane_verification.

On read/head-resolution failure, the exact command, key stderr excerpt, suspected cause and required human next action are appended to .ai/audit.jsonl, this task is marked failed, and the case is handed off to ERP-085; no silent loop and no doc-only closure is acceptable.

No file under src/ERP.* was modified, no production database or OSS was accessed or changed, no deployment or release occurred, and LIVE_TRADING=false plus ALLOW_EXTERNAL_ORDER_SUBMISSION=false are preserved.

No business logic, production database, production OSS, deployment or release is involved. AUTO_CIRCUIT_BREAKER still requires explicit human re-review, and any environment read failure routes to ERP-085 (L3 human gate).
